Results.ReviewText: I have used a Kettle Grill for many years, and decided it was time to replace my tried and true Weber. I can't even bring myself to get rid of the previous one, so I now have a spare! I looked for other brands but have never had a problem with the Kettle Grill and cook my Thanksgiving Turkey in it every year. Everyone loves the flavor, and it frees up the ovens for other food.
Results.Title: Weber 2.0 Replacement Grill

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your thoughtful review regarding the Original Kettle Charcoal grill 22''. So glad to hear you are enjoying your new grill. We appreciate your feedback about the lid resting design, this insight helps us continue improving our products. If you need any further assistance please reach out to us direct. Thank you and happy grilling!

Results.ReviewText: I really like this kettle grill. It is a great basic grill for the beginner grilling with charcoal. I would like some of the features to be better. The lid resting is very cumbersome and awkward to use. Other than that a solid grill.
Results.Title: really good kettle grill

Results.ReviewText: I’ve wanted to get back to grilling on a charcoal grill. The food just tastes better
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Bought a new one as my old Weber of over 20 years finally gave out.
Results.Title: Love Weber grills!

Results.ReviewText: Call me EJ's kettle bbq... I am the certified grill CEO of the family. The big secret..... Use a Weber.
Results.Title: EJ's weber

ClientResponses.Response:
We value your feedback, and we will make sure it reaches the right teams. We apologize for the disappointing experience with your new grill. We expect a higher level of quality from our products.

We would like to know more about your experience so we can pass this feedback to our Quality Assurance team. Please look for our email outreach soon. Thank you for being a long-time Weber griller.
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: The quality of the grill is severely lacking compared to the grill I have purchased over 50-plus years!  What a disappointment!  The grill that holds the charcoal has sharp edges where you can cut yourself, and the braces that hold the grill were bent different directions.  I had to take a pair of players to straighten them.  Not the same Weber quality!!!
Results.Title: DISAPPOINTED!!!

Results.ReviewText: Haven't cooked over coals in quite a bit, but there is no disputing the increased flavor profile over gas it provides. I had a Weber kettle years ago and just repurchased. Great quality as I had recalled, and much better overall quality than cheaper offbrand alternatives.
Results.Title: Won backover

Results.ReviewText: This grill is a classic. I find it’s the best way to grill steaks, fish or vegetables!  Takes little time to load charcoal, I use ‘match lite’ charcoal and it’s ready in less than 15mins. Plenty of time to cook a great meal perfectly!  Also use cast iron pan to grill vegetables which makes perfectly caramelized veggies for fajitas or just on the plate. I get about 10 years life out of these grills on the west coast of Florida. Key is to keep them clean but don’t wash.
Results.Title: Great grill, best for steak and grilled fish!

Results.ReviewText: This is my third Weber Kettle grill. The first two each lasted me about 7–10 years, so I’m clearly a fan. This newer model feels a little lighter than the older ones, which makes me wonder about durability, but I’m hoping it outlasts the previous two and keeps up the Weber reputation for quality.
Results.Title: Best Grill Hands Down

Results.ReviewText: The most versatile grill on the market. You can do anything with the weber kettle. Every household should have a weber kettle
Results.Title: The do all

Results.ReviewText: Great grill and even beater warranty from Webber!!
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: There is no better charcoal grill! I have 2- 22” Kettles, a 14” Smokey Joe, and a 18” Smokey Mountain smoker.
Results.Title: These grills will make you a grill master!

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback is very important to us. We’re sorry to hear the legs do not easily slide into the bowl. Your satisfaction is important to us, and we want to help. Please look for an outreach email from our Care Team soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: replaced my 20 year old weber. when assembling the new weber, the leg would not slide into the weber base. i had to sand the ends of the legs and hammer them into the base. i take my grill with me when i travel, so i must hammer them in and out every time i assemble it. otherwise, i enjoy the new grill
Results.Title: new weber

Results.ReviewText: This is the first time I've used a grill of this type. I've always used rectangular ones, and the difference is huge. I'm very satisfied with the purchase.
Results.Title: excellent purchasing decision

Results.ReviewText: Well made, just as they have been made for many decades
Results.Title: Well made grill

Results.ReviewText: This grill really needs no explanation. Awesome quality and great performance. I wouldn’t expect anything less. If you never had experience with these grills, grab one and see for yourself!
Results.Title: Original 22” Kettle

Results.ReviewText: It works as designed and the flavor of the food is awesome.
Results.Title: My review.

Results.ReviewText: What can I say, this is my 5th weber kettle grill. I've been using them forever. What's not to love. I tend to really use them a lot. Till something burns through.
Results.Title: 5th time is definitely a charm

Results.ReviewText: I have had Weber charcoal Kettles for many years. They still are consistently well built and designed.
Results.Title: Consistently Excellent

Results.ReviewText: Great grill for a great price ,can't go wrong with that carcoal flavor
Results.Title: Sundays are grill days with the Carcoal kettle

Results.OriginalProductName: Barbecue au charbon Original Kettle 22 po

Results.ReviewText: Love this bbq it's simple and no frills but the beauty is in the simplicity. The only complaint is the legs are just a little wobbly but not enough to not not recommend
Results.Title: Great unit

Results.ReviewText: I am a Weber fan and family member!  I have always loved Weber products and absolutely are a Weber charcoil grill FAN AND LOVER!  Excellent grills and products!
Results.Title: Weber Fan

Results.ReviewText: Had Jumbo Joe for decades and it worked well, but needed more capacity when we grilled for more than our just family. Bought the Original size grill recently and love it. It’s nice to have the bigger, higher surface and better control of the air flow.
Results.Title: Upgrade to the Original

Results.ReviewText: Purchased after a cousin prepared pork sausages on a Weber and couldn't believe the taste difference to propane grilling. Now using the Weber 99% of the time! It takes a little more time to setup but it is entirely worth the wait :)
Results.Title: Fantastic!

Results.ReviewText: Nothing beats cooking on real charcoal and nothing beats a weber grill. Easy assembly . Cooks great. Love it.
Results.Title: Awesome grill

Results.ReviewText: Had to return grill because the lid did NOT FIT. 2nd grill lid works okay.  Not as well as. My old grill

Results.ReviewText: still a great grill, but the ports are not as solid as the older Weber's, doesn't choke off the flame and charcoal, ports are a little lose. Was easy to assemble and directions were clear.
Results.Title: Still a great grill

Results.ReviewText: This is my first Kettle Grill and so far so good. I've been using a smoker for a number of years so it took a little getting used to how much charcoal I need for whatever heat is preferred. I haven't smoked anything in it yet so that will be the next project. Maybe a chicken. As far as the assembly, it was so easy I didn't even need my wife to help.
Results.Title: First Kettle

Results.ReviewText: My first time buying my own grill and I couldn’t be happier! My son and daughter were able to build it and my son‘s been grilling up a storm at 15 years old. The food comes out incredible. It’s easy to use and I’m just overall happy with the product.
Results.Title: Easy and Delicious ! Best bbq there is !
